meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 它把你给的来源（目录、URL、粘贴的笔记，或刚才这段对话里做的事）提炼成一个可复用技能，写出 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md，也可能附带脚本、参考或模板文件。如果这个主题已有技能，它会就地更新而不是重写。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」「把这个变成技能」等说法，或给出目录、URL、笔记、刚才的工作要求捕获成技能时触发。它只创建或改进技能，不安装现成技能。

say.text: /learn ./某个项目 —— 给这个项目建一个技能
/learn what we just did —— 把刚才的步骤变成技能
say.note: 从当前对话提炼可复用流程。

say.text: 更新 learn-pdf 技能，把新踩的坑补进去
say.note: 就地更新该技能的 SKILL.md。

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or this conversation's work into a reusable skill, writing .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (plus optional scripts/ or templates/). If a skill already covers the topic, it updates it in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say /learn, "turn this into a skill", "capture this workflow", or point it at a directory, URL, notes, or work just done. It creates or refines skills, not installs existing ones.

say_en.text: /learn ./my-project — build a skill for this project
say_en.note: Reads the directory, then writes SKILL.md.

say_en.text: /learn what we just did — turn these steps into a skill
say_en.note: Distills the conversation into a new skill.

say_en.text: Update the learn-pdf skill with the new gotchas
say_en.note: Updates that skill's SKILL.md in place.
